title: Transfer a vehicle registration as the carer or guardian of a registered operator
summary: Carers or guardians can transfer a vehicle registration on behalf of a registered operator by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro: If you're a carer or guardian and need to transfer the registration of a vehicle on behalf of the registered operator, please visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: You must be a carer or guardian needing to transfer the registration of a vehicle on behalf of a registered operator.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for Transfer of Registration' (https://tfnswforms.transport.nsw.gov.au/45070107-transfer-of-reg.pdf)
The carer/guardian's pensioner concession card in the name of the registered operator

Proof of registration entitlement in the name of the registered operator or carer/guardian (https://www.nsw.gov.au/driving-boating-and-transport/vehicle-registration/basics/proof-of-registration-entitlement)
Proof of compulsory third party (CTP) insurance
An unregistered vehicle inspection report (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the form in the applicant's name (the carer or guardian).
Make sure you have all the required documents.
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.

external_links.text: Application for Transfer of Registration – PDF

internal_links.text: Apply for a vehicle registration as the carer or guardian of the registered operator
Renew a vehicle registration as the carer or guardian of the registered operator

faqs.q: Where do I go to transfer the vehicle registration?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to transfer the registration.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to transfer the registration?
faqs.a: You need the 'Application for Transfer of Registration' form, the carer/guardian's pensioner concession card (in the registered operator's name), proof of registration entitlement, proof of CTP insurance, and an unregistered vehicle inspection report (if applicable).

faqs.q: Who should fill out the transfer form?
faqs.a: The form must be completed in the name of the applicant (the carer or guardian).
